## Drawbacks of the approach

```{=html}
<svg class="autoq3 why-grid" viewBox="0 0 940 400" role="img" aria-label="Drawbacks of the approach: validation debt piles up, deferred work makes it unclear what was tested and why, manual docs drift out of sync with the code, teams skip updates to avoid re-qualification.">
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="0">
    <rect x="20" y="10" width="440" height="130" rx="14" class="aq3-card"/>
    <text x="70" y="75" class="why-icon">📈</text>
    <text x="115" y="58" class="why-title">Validation debt piles up</text>
    <text x="115" y="92" class="why-sub">delays releases &amp; increases risk</text>
    <circle cx="20" cy="75" r="16" class="aq3-badge"/>
    <text x="20" y="75" class="aq3-badge-num">1</text>
  </g>

  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1">
    <rect x="480" y="10" width="440" height="130" rx="14" class="aq3-card"/>
    <text x="530" y="75" class="why-icon">🔍</text>
    <text x="575" y="44" class="why-title">Deferred work</text>
    <text x="575" y="78" class="why-sub">makes it hard to reconstruct</text>
    <text x="575" y="106" class="why-sub"><tspan font-style="italic">what</tspan> was tested and <tspan font-style="italic">why</tspan></text>
    <circle cx="480" cy="75" r="16" class="aq3-badge"/>
    <text x="480" y="75" class="aq3-badge-num">2</text>
  </g>

  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2">
    <rect x="20" y="160" width="440" height="130" rx="14" class="aq3-card"/>
    <text x="70" y="225" class="why-icon">🔀</text>
    <text x="115" y="208" class="why-title">Manual docs drift</text>
    <text x="115" y="242" class="why-sub">out of sync with the code</text>
    <circle cx="20" cy="225" r="16" class="aq3-badge"/>
    <text x="20" y="225" class="aq3-badge-num">3</text>
  </g>

  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="3">
    <rect x="480" y="160" width="440" height="130" rx="14" class="aq3-card"/>
    <text x="530" y="225" class="why-icon">🚫</text>
    <text x="575" y="208" class="why-title">Teams skip updates</text>
    <text x="575" y="242" class="why-sub">to avoid re-qualification</text>
    <circle cx="480" cy="225" r="16" class="aq3-badge"/>
    <text x="480" y="225" class="aq3-badge-num">4</text>
  </g>
</svg>
```

::: notes
This shift was important for several reasons. First, accumulating "validation debt" can delay releases and increase risk, as teams are left with a large amount of qualification work at the end of the cycle. Second, when qualification is deferred, it becomes much harder to reconstruct what was tested, why it was tested, and what evidence supports the results. Finally, manually maintained qualification documents often drift out of sync with the code itself, creating additional maintenance challenges. In some cases, teams may even avoid adopting new releases or updates simply to avoid the burden of re-qualification. These challenges highlighted the need for a more automated, repeatable, and scalable approach, which ultimately drove our effort to redesign the entire qualification framework.
:::
